authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong photorealism in environmental rendering (straw texture, depth of field, lighting) and facial anatomy. However, significant structural artifacts exist in the limb regions. The animal pose auditor's HIGH risk flag (76% low-confidence keypoints) correlates with visible fusion of legs in the central cluster where individual limbs merge into the straw and each other. Additionally, the blue coloration lacks subsurface scattering or natural variation, appearing as a flat shader rather than biological pigment. These anatomical and textural inconsistencies prevent a higher authenticity score despite excellent face rendering.
key_defects: Limb fusion in central cluster (individual legs indistinguishable)
Unnatural uniform blue texture lacking biological subsurface scattering
High pose estimation uncertainty confirming structural ambiguity in lower body
